subject: Important Update: Changes to Billing Cycle
body: Dear valued customer, we wanted to inform you about some changes to our billing cycle starting next month. Due to recent system upgrades, we have adjusted the billing dates to better align with our service delivery schedule. This change will ensure a more seamless billing process for you. Please review your upcoming invoices carefully to familiarize yourself with the new dates. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
